findWorkspace.title: Find your workspace
findWorkspace.intro: Enter the workspace manager's email address. If it manages a LiwanOS workspace, we send its address there.
findWorkspace.sent: If this address manages a workspace, we sent its address to it. The message can take a few minutes; check your spam folder too.
findWorkspace.noWorkspace: No workspace yet? Start your free trial

errors.invalid: Check the address you typed and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.humanCheckFailed: The security check did not pass. Complete it again, then try once more.
errors.humanCheckUnavailable: We could not reach the security check, so we cannot send right now. Try again in a few minutes.
